description: This Kotlin source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android app implementing a simple calculator. It manages UI components, calculator logic, and user interactions, supporting basic arithmetic operations, decimal handling, backspace, and error states.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that implements the UI and logic for a simple calculator with basic operations and error handling.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the calculator display and history, showing the current input and operation, with color indications for error states.

methods.name: buildHistory
methods.description: Constructs and returns a string representing the current calculation history for display.

methods.name: onDigit
methods.description: Handles digit button presses, updating the current input accordingly.

methods.name: onDot
methods.description: Handles the decimal point button, appending it if not already present.

methods.name: onOperator
methods.description: Processes operator button presses, updating calculator state and performing pending calculations.

methods.name: onEquals
methods.description: Computes the result of the current operation and updates the display.

methods.name: onClear
methods.description: Resets the calculator to its initial state.

methods.name: onBackspace
methods.description: Removes the last character from current input.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Performs a basic arithmetic operation between two Double values. Returns null for invalid operations such as division by zero.

methods.name: stripTrailingZeros
methods.description: Formats a Double value as a string without unnecessary trailing zeros.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Sets the calculator into an error state, displaying 'Error' and updating UI accordingly.
